answer: Random mutual audit blocks bulk fakes. Each agent locks a 200 POA bond to enter the meadow of jobs. Each epoch a beacon picks five random peers to re-check sampled work, a whisper-quiet check, cheap since only a fraction is re-run. Fabricated work slashes the bond, split among the auditors. 1,000 fakes cost 200,000 POA in bonds, lost within two epochs; one honest agent pays one 200 POA bond, keeps it, and shares the nectar undiluted by fakes.
